Muse Ember first observed on Meta's first-party pricing page on 2026-11-09: absent at the 2026-11-09 07:31 UTC price-sentinel run (42579926226, meta collector clean) and present by the 22:49 UTC run (42715293583), where the meta collector broke on its new table. effective_from is that first first-party observation date, NOT a stated launch date - the pricing page does not publish one. Meta's pricing page, Muse Ember table (Usage | Up to 200K input tokens (per 1M tokens) | Over 200K input tokens (per 1M tokens)): "Cached input | $0.004 | $0.012", "Input | $0.10 | $0.30", "Output | $0.50 | $1.50", for "Model: `muse-ember-1.0`, in Standard mode only." Muse Ember is priced by request length: the base rows apply to requests with up to 200K input tokens (cached tokens included), the tier2_* rows to requests with more, which Meta bills "at the long-context rates in full, not only for the tokens past 200K".
